headline: Monday slate: ALDS Game 2s (White Sox @ Guardians, Yankees @ Rays), Falcons @ Saints on Monday Night Football, a 4-game NHL card, Nations League at 11:45 AM PT (France-Belgium, Italy-Türkiye), and NBA preseason. No WNBA today — the semis resume Wednesday. Golf is Baycurrent Classic futures.

record.label: Last board (Fri 10/2)
record.note: A bad Friday: soccer went 1-5 and every NHL game bet except Boston lost. Hits: Bruins ML, Northwestern, Idaho (won outright), Shepard rebounds, Güler SOT, G. Williams under, Keefer over Hall. Thursday's three golf picks all cashed (Ben James T5, Brennan T13, Keefer T10).

notes: No bet is a lock. 'Confidence' runs 1–5, and nothing on this board is above a 3 today — stakes are trimmed after Friday.
Nations League kicks off at 11:45 AM PT — bet those first or skip them.
Odds move. Skip any pick whose price is past the 'playable to' number in its reasoning. Prices marked 'estimate' weren't confirmed at a book — check yours.
Same-game parlay (SGP) prices are set by the book and pay less than the multiplied odds shown here.

sections.label: Best of the Day
sections.slate: The strongest edges across today's card. Friday these went 3-5 (the Bruins, Shepard and Güler hit; the soccer and totals didn't). Two underdogs lead the way today.

straight.reasoning: Atlanta has won the last two meetings and gets Michael Penix Jr. back; he ranked top-4 in EPA per dropback last week. New Orleans is thin at linebacker and missing three front-seven starters, and its defense ranks 26th in points allowed (27.7 per game). Atlanta's defense ranks 3rd in success rate. The line has already moved from Saints -2.5 to -1.5. Playable to +100; if it flips to Falcons favored, take the spread instead.

Gavin Williams leads the AL in strikeouts, but he had a 5.03 ERA this season when pitching on extra rest, and he hasn't thrown since Sept. 25 because of Cleveland's bye. Chicago opens with Anthony Kay and then goes to Sean Burke, who has a 1.04 ERA in 17 innings against Cleveland this year. The Sox won the season series 7-6 and held Cleveland to three hits in Game 1. Covers and RG.org both take Chicago. Playable to +120.

Game 1 ended 1-0. Cam Schlittler (1.95 ERA, 93rd-percentile xERA) faces Freddy Peralta, who has a 3.25 ERA since joining Tampa Bay. Tampa's offense has a .293 xwOBA over the last 30 days, and both teams' over/under splits lean Under. Playable to -120.

parlay.title: Two Favorites vs. Weakened Opponents
parlay.reasoning: Winnipeg is on a back-to-back with backup Clay Stevenson (five NHL games) in net, against a Pittsburgh team that has scored 13 goals in two games. Türkiye is 0-3 in the group, lost 4-1 to Italy a week ago, and is without Arda Güler (suspended) and Barış Alper Yılmaz. Two expensive favorites combine to pay a bit better than 5-to-4.

parlay.title: Monday Underdog Double
parlay.reasoning: The two best straight bets on the board, combined. Both are underdogs, so this pays about 4-to-1 — a quarter unit only.

props.reasoning: In the last seven games London and Penix have played together, London topped 100 yards in all but one, averaging 120 yards. Covers projects him at 86. The Saints' banged-up linebackers make the middle of the field easier to attack. Price is an estimate; playable to -130.

Dimers' model gives Malkin a 46.5% chance at an assist against 43.5% implied — one of its biggest edges tonight. Pittsburgh has 13 goals in two games and faces a backup goalie on a back-to-back. Plus money on a near coin flip. Playable to +115.

With Mbappé injured, Olise is France's main creator: 14 direct goal contributions in his last 10 games, and he scored the late winner against Belgium last week. Belgium is without De Bruyne and Tielemans (both suspended) and Courtois. Playable to -180.

sections.label: Baseball
sections.slate: Two ALDS Game 2s. White Sox lead Cleveland 1-0 (2:00 PM PT, TBS); Rays lead the Yankees 1-0 (5:00 PM PT, TBS). The NLDS is off today: Dodgers-Braves is tied 1-1 and the Brewers lead San Diego 2-0; both resume Tuesday.

straight.reasoning: Gavin Williams had a 5.03 ERA on extra rest this season, and opponents' OPS rose 62 points in those starts; he last pitched Sept. 25. Chicago's opener-plus-Sean Burke plan (Burke: 1.04 ERA in 17 IP vs Cleveland) already held the Guardians to three hits in Game 1. Cleveland ranked 24th in runs scored. Playable to +120.

Game 1 was 1-0. Schlittler has a 1.95 ERA and a sinker allowing a .321 expected slugging percentage; Peralta has a 3.25 ERA since his trade to Tampa. Tampa's bats are cold (.293 xwOBA last 30 days). Playable to -120.

parlay.title: ALDS Monday Double
parlay.reasoning: Both ALDS straight bets together, about 3.6-to-1. The White Sox game ends first, so you'll know by 5 PM whether the second leg is live.

props.reasoning: The Yankees have struck out in 30.5% of plate appearances recently, and Peralta's curveball drew a 31.6% whiff rate this season. Covers' prop pick. Price is an estimate; playable to -140.

sections.label: Football
sections.slate: Monday Night Football: Falcons @ Saints, 5:15 PM PT. Saints -1.5 (opened -2.5), total 47.5. Both defenses are short-handed: Atlanta is missing James Pearce and Jalon Walker; New Orleans has several linebackers out or questionable.

straight.reasoning: Atlanta has won the last two meetings, Penix is back, and Bijan Robinson is coming off a 200-yard game. The Saints allow 27.7 points per game (26th). Money has moved toward Atlanta since the open. Playable to +100.
Atlanta scored 35 at Green Bay on just 25 pass attempts, and both defenses are missing starters. Yahoo's main pick. A lean, so a half unit — Friday's totals went 0-3.

parlay.title: Penix-to-London (SGP)
parlay.reasoning: If London has a big night, Atlanta probably wins — the legs are correlated, which is why the book will price this lower than shown. London's prop price is an estimate.

props.reasoning: London has 100+ yards in six of his last seven games with Penix (120 per game) and Covers projects 86. Price is an estimate; playable to -130.
If he's getting 100+ yards, a red-zone target or a long score is likely to come with it. Plus money, quarter unit.

sections.label: Soccer
sections.slate: UEFA Nations League at 11:45 AM PT: France vs Belgium, Italy vs Türkiye, Romania vs Sweden, Bosnia vs Poland and more. France is without Mbappé (injured) and Upamecano (suspended); Belgium is without De Bruyne, Tielemans and Courtois.

straight.reasoning: Italy beat Türkiye 4-1 in Bursa a week ago and is at home in Bologna. Türkiye is 0-3 with a -7 goal difference and is missing its two best attackers, Arda Güler (suspended) and Barış Alper Yılmaz. Expensive, so a half unit. Playable to -250.

France has scored just three goals in three group games without Mbappé (1-0, 1-0, 1-1), and last week's meeting was 1-0. Belgium loses its two best midfielders to suspension. Price is an estimate — skip it worse than -140.

parlay.title: Home Favorites Double
parlay.reasoning: France has won its last six against Belgium, and Belgium is missing De Bruyne, Tielemans and Courtois. Italy faces a winless, depleted Türkiye. Both favorites are too pricey alone; together they pay about +115. Both settle at the same time.

props.reasoning: France's creator-in-chief with Mbappé out: 14 goal contributions in 10 games, and he scored the winner in last week's meeting. Confirm he starts (lineups post about an hour before kickoff). Playable to -180.

sections.label: Hockey
sections.slate: Four games: Flyers @ Lightning (4:00 PM PT), Jets @ Penguins and Senators @ Bruins (4:30), Sharks @ Stars (5:00). Winnipeg is on a back-to-back with backup Clay Stevenson in goal.

straight.reasoning: Same idea that cashed with Boston on Friday: Winnipeg is still without Hellebuyck, and tonight it's Clay Stevenson (five career NHL games) on the second night of a back-to-back. Pittsburgh is 2-0 with 13 goals. Playable to -190.

Philadelphia is allowing 4.33 goals and 40.7 shots a game, and Tampa has won four straight in the series. The -200 moneyline is poor value; the puck line pays plus money for a two-goal win. Playable to +105.

parlay.title: Monday Home Favorites
parlay.reasoning: The two hockey straight bets together, about 2.5-to-1.

props.reasoning: Dimers: 46.5% model probability vs 43.5% implied. Pittsburgh's offense is rolling and faces a backup goalie on tired legs. Playable to +115.
Dimers rates him at 42.8% against 40% implied, versus a Flyers defense that gives up more than 40 shots a night. Thin edge, quarter unit.
He's scored in 40% of games since Jan. 1 but is priced around 30%, and his ice time is up almost two minutes a game. He faces backup Clay Stevenson. Price is an estimate; skip below +200.

sections.label: Golf
sections.slate: No golf today. Bank of Utah final: Austin Smotherman won at -26 for his first Tour title. Next up is the Baycurrent Classic at Yokohama Country Club, Japan (72 players, no cut), starting Wednesday night PT. Schauffele is the defending champ and favorite (+930). These are futures — bet now, settle Sunday.

straight.reasoning: He finished 3rd here last year and just broke through with his first Tour win at the Rocket Classic. A recent winner with course form at 24-to-1 in a 72-man, no-cut field. Quarter unit.

Runner-up in each of the last two editions of this event. Course fit doesn't get much clearer than that, and 57-to-1 pays well if he finally closes. Quarter unit; check for each-way or top-5 terms at your book.

sections.label: Basketball
sections.slate: No WNBA today — Golden State took Game 1 from the Aces 71-60 Sunday, and both semis resume Wednesday. NBA preseason: Grizzlies-Hawks, Suns @ Pistons, Knicks @ 76ers, Timberwolves-Bucks, Lakers-Kings. Preseason minutes are unpredictable, so stakes are tiny.

straight.reasoning: A home game against a division rival, where Covers expects Philadelphia's staff to play starters more than usual to set an early tone. Preseason, so confidence is minimal. Price is an estimate.
Devin Booker plays in his Detroit hometown and Miles Bridges debuts near his college home, while Detroit's Jalen Duren missed training camp. Covers' underdog pick. Price is an estimate.
